article.body_preview:
Bangladesh - Petroleum Corporation could have used the Tk 46,858 crore profit it made since 2015 to continue the subsidy on fuel and thus prevent the price hike, the Centre for Policy Dialogue said yesterday.

The BPC could also have offset the losses it has been incurring over the last six months, said the think-tank, asking the government to disclose what happened to the BPC's profits.
